name: Treat unloaded extra-usage state as enabled (fix 1M-context load race)
description: Flips the conservative default in isExtraUsageEnabled() so that when the cached extra-usage disabled reason has not yet loaded (undefined), it is treated as enabled (true) instead of disabled (false).
archive_reason: excluded-by-policy: flips extra-usage / 1M-context default on (paid entitlement).
